text: Prioritize attacks that block the opponent's expansion path toward their home, especially when it isolates their central cells and forces them to lose strength over time.
trigger: When the opponent's cells form a line toward their home and you can attack to create a barrier, cutting off their connection.

text: When an opponent captures a cell adjacent to your home, prioritize reinforcing or claiming nearby cells to prevent further incursions.
trigger: An enemy successfully attacks and captures a cell near your home area

text: Prioritize creating contiguous lines adjacent to your home to isolate enemy cells and force them to lose strength.
trigger: When you can expand to form a connected territory near your home that blocks the opponent's expansion path.

text: Prioritize reinforcing or defending central cells when an opponent threatens to disrupt your expansion path.
trigger: An enemy attacks a key central cell that is part of your expansion strategy.

text: Avoid creating single-point connections between your territories; instead, build overlapping links to prevent enemies from severing your expansion with a single attack.
trigger: when expanding into new areas, ensure they are connected through multiple adjacent cells rather than a single bridge

text: Prioritize blocking the opponent's expansion into the central corridor (columns C and D) to prevent them from establishing a direct path to the center, especially when they are near their home base.
trigger: opponent expanding towards central corridor near their home

text: Prioritize defending cells that connect your territory to prevent isolation.
trigger: when an enemy is positioned to attack a cell critical for maintaining connectivity between your cells and your home base

text: Prioritize connecting cells in a column adjacent to your home base to block opponent expansion and secure dominance in that quadrant.
trigger: A player claims a cell that completes a vertical column adjacent to their home base, creating a solid flank.

text: Prioritize capturing enemy cells adjacent to your home to disrupt their expansion and gain a cell count advantage.
trigger: An enemy cell is adjacent to your home and vulnerable to attack

text: Attack adjacent enemy cells that are part of their expansion path to block reinforcement and create separation
trigger: When an enemy cell is adjacent and part of their connected expansion route
